sentences.en: The Beaker People were named after the shape of their pots.
sentences.zh: 贝克人是以他们陶器的形状而得名。

sentences.en: Broken test tubes, cracked beakers - the work of careless students in the laboratory.
sentences.zh: 破碎的试管，裂开的烧杯——这是实验室里粗心的学生们造成的。

sentences.en: The chemistry teacher asked us to measure out exactly 50 milliliters using a beaker.
sentences.zh: 化学老师要求我们用烧杯量取正好50毫升的液体。
